title: The Earth seen from space without clouds, by day (Blue Marble) and by night (Black Marble)
provider: NASA Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), Earth Science Data and Information System (ESDIS)
licence: NASA imagery: no restrictions on use; acknowledge NASA GIBS and the data source (NASA Earthdata use policy)
credit: NASA GIBS, Blue Marble, Black Marble

layer.description: GIBS layer without time, such as BlueMarble_NextGeneration, BlueMarble_ShadedRelief_Bathymetry or VIIRS_Black_Marble

width.description: Width of the image in pixels (360°)

height.description: Height of the image in pixels (180°)

blue-marble.description: Blue Marble Next Generation: the land surface without clouds, with bathymetry, 8192 x 4096

black-marble.description: Black Marble (VIIRS, 2016): the lights of the Earth at night, 8192 x 4096

format: JPEG, equirectangular (EPSG:4326), longitude -180 to 180, latitude 90 to -90
coverage: Global; Blue Marble Next Generation (Stöckli et al. 2005), Black Marble 2016 (Román et al. 2018)
citation: Stöckli, R., et al. (2005). The Blue Marble Next Generation, NASA Earth Observatory; Román, M. O., et al. (2018). NASA's Black Marble nighttime lights product suite. Remote Sens. Environ. 210, 113-143; imagery through NASA GIBS.
